releaseNotes:
1. Collapsible Tower Phase Identification: Tower marker info popup opens in a clean, compact collapsed state with Location Number, Coordinates, Feeder Name, Cumulative Distance, and bottom action buttons (Start Line, Delete), leaving maximum map area visible.
2. Expand & Collapse Controls: Added a prominent 'View Phase Details' / 'Hide Phase Details' button and an integrated 3-dot popup menu action with smooth expansion animations.
3. Detailed Phase Schematic Display: When expanded, displays configuration name, conductor phase assignments (R, Y, B), DC double-circuit layout, SC on DC unused positions, and transition arrangements with Full View and Edit Phase buttons.
4. Unconfigured Tower Handling: Displays 'Phase Configuration Not Set' with direct 'Edit Phase' access and no assumed diagrams.
5. State Reset: Automatically reverts to collapsed state when another tower is tapped or the popup is closed.

previousStableRelease.releaseNotes:
1. Tower Phase Identification & Configuration: Full support for Double Circuit (DC on DC), Single Circuit (SC on SC, SC on DC), and Transition Towers (DC to SC, SC to DC) with standard R, Y, B phase color coding and interactive tower schematics.
2. Viewing Reference & Feeder Orientation: Configure Station A to Station B viewing directions with Front View and Rear View conductor perspective transformation.
3. Bulk Phase Configuration: Rapid multi-tower phase assignment with feeder range selection (natural numeric, tension, and slash-separated formats).
4. Compact Tower Marker Card: Streamlined 5-row bottom sheet with quick phase badges, side action buttons, and direct editor access.
5. Structured SQLite Storage & History: Robust database schema with audit trail for tower phase modifications and safety backup snapshots.
